categories.main_business_segments: Haimo Technologies Group Corp. primarily operates in oil and gas field high-end equipment manufacturing, technical services, and digital business. Its main product lines include multiphase flow meters and related services, downhole testing and production enhancement instruments and tools, fracturing equipment and related services, oilfield special vehicles, environmental protection equipment, and oil and gas sales. The company integrates R&D, manufacturing, sales, and services in its business model.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on proprietary technologies in multiphase flow measurement, downhole testing, production optimization instruments, fracturing pump hydraulic ends, and oilfield digitalization. It employs advanced manufacturing and R&D methods, including electronic and mechanical integration for underwater flow meters, smart layered injection systems, and fracturing equipment with improved durability and cost efficiency. The company holds over 365 patents and 145 software copyrights, emphasizing innovation and technology-driven product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haimo serves major domestic and international oil and gas companies, including China National Offshore Oil Corporation (CNOOC), Saudi Aramco, Oman Oil Company, and other global oilfield service providers. Its products and services cater to oilfield operators requiring exploration, production optimization, and digital transformation solutions. The customer base spans upstream oil and gas exploration, drilling, and production sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and key international markets such as the Middle East (Oman, UAE, Saudi Arabia), North America (USA), and Latin America (Colombia). It maintains subsidiaries and offices in these regions, with significant sales and service networks in domestic oilfields and overseas oil and gas exploration areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haimo operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the oil and gas equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing high-end oilfield equipment and providing technical and digital services directly to oilfield operators. It controls R&D, production, sales, and after-sales service, positioning itself as an integrated equipment and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation in multiphase flow measurement, downhole testing, fracturing equipment, and digital oilfield solutions. Key R&D projects include development of underwater multiphase flow meters, chemical injection valves, lightweight fracturing hydraulic ends, and intelligent layered injection systems. It aims to break foreign technology monopolies, enhance product reliability, and expand digital and intelligent oilfield technologies to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Haimo generates revenue mainly through direct sales of oilfield equipment and instruments, complemented by service contracts including equipment maintenance, testing, and digital oilfield services. It also earns income from equipment leasing, oil and gas sales, and related technical services. The company uses a direct sales model supported by a global sales and service network.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haimo is a leading domestic private enterprise in oilfield multiphase flow measurement and production optimization solutions, competing with large state-owned oilfield equipment service companies in China. Internationally, it serves major oil companies and competes in specialized segments with global oilfield service providers. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary technology, product quality, and integrated service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haimo reported revenue of approximately RMB 599.8 million, a 19.36% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -228.4 million due to intensified competition and market demand changes. Despite the loss, operating cash flow remained positive at RMB 98.7 million. The company completed a private placement in 2023, improving liquidity and capital structure, and continues to focus on core product lines for future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haimo emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high-quality products, and comprehensive service offerings as key differentiators. It provides accurate, reliable, and real-time multiphase flow measurement solutions, intelligent downhole testing and production enhancement tools, and advanced fracturing equipment tailored to customer needs. The company’s ability to innovate and localize products, break foreign technology monopolies, and offer integrated digital oilfield solutions creates significant customer value and competitive advantage.
